sections.Profile:
Scuba , released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1970, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Art Stenholm. The game features a captivating underwater theme, incorporating elements of mermaids, scuba diving, and ocean mythology.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Women, Myth, Swimming, Original Theme, Scuba Diving, 1970s, Water, Fantasy
